description:
Monte Carlo price simulation for the next ~10 trading days: thousands of
    random price paths estimate a likely price range and the odds of finishing
    higher.

    Returns the price-history date and starting close, mean and median
    projected close, the 90% range, daily volatility, support/resistance and
    the chance of finishing above resistance. It also returns the simulated
    distribution of day-10 closes: percentiles (p5-p95), a 40-bin histogram
    (price range and path count per bin) and a Gaussian KDE curve on the same
    count scale - enough to chart the distribution as a histogram with the 90%
    range, mean and resistance marked. The simulation is seeded from the price
    history, so repeated calls on the same data return the same numbers.

    Args:
        ticker: Stock symbol, e.g. "AAPL".
name: get_monte_carlo
title: Monte Carlo Simulation
